edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

config_file.description: Path to a YAML config file with api_token, region, and optional phisher_api_token. Defaults to KNOWBE4_CONFIG_FILE or ~/.knowbe4-inspector/config.yaml.

timeout_seconds.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

redact_pii.description: Replace user emails and names with stable pseudonyms in findings and exported data. Defaults to KNOWBE4_REDACT_PII or false.

tools.name: knowbe4_export_audit_bundle
tools.label: Export KnowBe4 audit bundle
tools.description: Export a KnowBe4 audit package covering all 20 spec controls: raw Reporting API snapshots in core_data/, normalized findings and control coverage in analysis/, executive summary, unified matrix, and per-framework reports in compliance/, QUICK_REFERENCE.md, an _errors.log when collection is partial, and a zip archive.

api_token.description: KnowBe4 Reporting API key. Defaults to KNOWBE4_API_TOKEN, then api_token in ~/.knowbe4-inspector/config.yaml.

region.description: KnowBe4 hosting region that selects the API base URL: us, eu, ca, uk, or de. Defaults to KNOWBE4_REGION, then the config file, then us.

base_url.description: Override for the Reporting API base URL (normally derived from region, for example https://us.api.knowbe4.com). Defaults to KNOWBE4_BASE_URL.

phisher_api_token.description: Optional PhishER Product API key for GraphQL enrichment. Defaults to KNOWBE4_PHISHER_API_TOKEN, then phisher_api_token in the config file.

phisher_graphql_url.description: Override for the PhishER GraphQL endpoint (normally derived from region, for example https://training.knowbe4.com/graphql). Defaults to KNOWBE4_PHISHER_GRAPHQL_URL.

config_file.description: Path to a YAML config file with api_token, region, and optional phisher_api_token. Defaults to KNOWBE4_CONFIG_FILE or ~/.knowbe4-inspector/config.yaml.

timeout_seconds.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

redact_pii.description: Replace user emails and names with stable pseudonyms in findings and exported data. Defaults to KNOWBE4_REDACT_PII or false.

lookback_days.description: Analysis window in days for callback phishing tests. Defaults to 90.

user_limit.description: Maximum active users to load. Findings computed over the user list degrade to warn with user_limit_reached when the cap is hit. Defaults to 5000.

security_test_sample_limit.description: Number of most recent phishing security tests whose recipient results are loaded. Defaults to 12.

max_campaign_gap_days.description: Maximum days since the last phishing security test before control 1 fails. Defaults to 30.

min_coverage_pct.description: Minimum percentage of active users that must be tested or targeted (controls 2 and 9). Defaults to 90.

max_phish_prone_pct.description: Maximum acceptable phish-prone percentage (control 6). Defaults to 15.

min_report_rate_pct.description: Minimum Phish Alert Button report rate percentage (control 19). Defaults to 50.

max_schedule_gap_days.description: Maximum days between consecutive phishing security tests (control 20). Defaults to 45.

require_full_targeting.description: Whether policy requires active phishing campaigns to target all active users (control 9). Defaults to true.

phisher_message_limit.description: Maximum PhishER messages to load for report-rate enrichment when a PhishER key is configured. Defaults to 1000.

training_lookback_days.description: Window in days for training campaigns, enrollments, and content review. Defaults to 365.

min_completion_pct.description: Training completion target percentage (controls 3 and 17). Defaults to 90.

fail_completion_pct.description: Completion percentage below which a training campaign fails control 3. Defaults to 80.

enrollment_grace_days.description: Days after joining within which a new user must be enrolled in training (control 4). Defaults to 30.

remedial_window_days.description: Days after a phishing failure allowed for remedial enrollment before the user counts as unremediated (control 10). Defaults to 14.

max_content_age_days.description: Maximum age in days of assigned training module publish dates before they are flagged stale (control 11). Defaults to 365.

required_compliance_topics.description: Compliance topics that must appear in assigned module names, for example HIPAA, PCI, GDPR (control 17). Defaults to auto-detecting compliance-themed content.

enrollment_limit.description: Maximum training enrollments to load for activity signals. Defaults to 20000.

inactive_days.description: Days without campaign participation or sign-in before an active user is considered inactive (control 18). Defaults to 180.

max_mean_risk_score.description: Maximum acceptable mean user risk score (control 5). Defaults to 50.

max_risk_score_stddev.description: Maximum acceptable standard deviation of user risk scores (control 5). Defaults to 25.

max_admin_count.description: Maximum console administrators before control 12 fails. Defaults to 3.

require_usb_tests.description: Whether policy requires USB drop tests (control 15). Set false to scope the control out; it is then reported as manual with the policy evidence to attach, never as pass. Defaults to true.

require_vishing_tests.description: Whether policy requires voice-channel (callback) phishing tests (control 16). Set false to scope the control out; it is then reported as manual with the policy evidence to attach, never as pass. Defaults to true.
